By  [Carley Garcia](https://gamerant.com/author/carley-garcia/)
Published Jan 23, 2025, 11:32 AM EST
Utterly obsessed with gaming, anime, and manga for the past 25 years, Carley attended Florida State University, graduating with a degree in Japanese in 2012. A professional Japanese/English translator for over a decade, she has worked largely in the pop culture sphere. In May 2020, she joined the team at OTAQUEST, specializing in lesser-known aspects of Japanese pop culture, rambling about retro games, forgotten anime series, and Tokyo’s indie musicians in her first official paid gig as a staff writer. She has continued to share her love for gaming by contributing hundreds of articles to sites such as Siliconera, PC Gamer, and VGKAMI.   

Carley spends her free time gaming with her husband, scoping out breweries and wineries, playing with her cat Momo, and writing self-indulgent fanfiction. She prefers lore-heavy RPGs and walking sims and has _only_ played Dragon Age: Inquisition 14 times. Her favorite Final Fantasy game is all of them.

### Summary
  * Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 was the best-selling game of 2024. 
  * Helldivers 2, Dragon Ball: Sparking Zero, and Elden Ring all appeared in the top 10, with titles like Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth and Tekken 8 rounding out the top 20. 
  * Consumers in the U.S. spent less on games overall, with spending down 1.1 percent to $58.7 billion. 


_**Call of Duty: Black Ops 6**_ was the best-selling game of 2024, according to a new report from Circana. While many in the gaming sphere won't be too shocked to hear that [_Call of Duty: Black Ops 6_](https://gamerant.com/db/video-game/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/) was the top seller last year, some titles appearing in the top 20 are a tad more surprising. 
2024 saw the release of many blockbuster titles, from _Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree_ and _Helldivers 2_ to _Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth_ and _Dragon's Dogma 2_. Some of the [top games of 2024](https://gamerant.com/top-best-video-game-2024/) shocked the community, with the indie poker-themed roguelike deck-building title _Balatro_ nominated alongside massive releases like _Black Myth: Wukong_ and _Metaphor: ReFantazio_ for Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2024. Gaming trends are always in flux, though some franchises seem to have more staying power than others, with a select few long-running series selling incredibly well last year.

By  [Dalton Cooper](https://gamerant.com/author/dalton/ "Posts by Dalton Cooper")
Feb 24, 2024
According to data from Circana and analysis by Mat Piscatella that was shared with [IGN](https://www.ign.com/articles/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-is-the-best-selling-game-of-2025-in-the-us), _Call of Duty: Black Ops 6_ was the best-selling game of 2024, followed by _EA Sports College Football 25_ and _Helldivers 2_. Five games in the top 10 were revealed to be sports titles, with _NBA 2K25_ , _Madden NFL 25_ , _EA Sports FC 25_ , and _EA Sports MVP Bundle_ all selling incredibly well in 2024. Likely due to the [release of the _Shadow of the Erdtree_ expansion](https://gamerant.com/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-console-release-date-sote-pc-launch-time/) in June 2024,_Elden Ring_ remained in the top 10 best-selling titles of the year. _Dragon Ball: Sparking Zero_ and _Tekken 8_ were the only fighting games to appear on the list, while _Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth_ , _Hogwarts Legacy_ , and _Dragon's Dogma 2_ were the major RPGs represented in the data. While no Nintendo titles appear on the list, this is potentially due to the fact that Nintendo does not share its digital sales data with Circana.

Notably, consumers in the U.S. spent less on games overall, with spending down 1.1 percent to $58.7 billion.

Forced to go rogue. Hunted from within. This is Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.  
  
Developed by Treyarch and Raven, Black Ops 6 is a spy action thriller set in the early 90s, a period of transition and upheaval in global politics, characterized by the end of the Cold War and the rise of the United States as a single superpower. With a mind-bending narrative, and unbound by the rules of engagement, this is signature Black Ops.  
  
The Black Ops 6 Campaign provides dynamic moment-to-moment gameplay that includes a variety of play spaces with blockbuster set pieces and action-packed moments, high-stakes heists, and cloak-and-dagger spy activity.  
  
In a best-in-class Multiplayer experience, players will test their skills across 16 new maps at launch, including 12 core 6v6 maps and 4 Strike maps that can be played 2v2 or 6v6.  
  
Black Ops 6 also marks the epic return of Round-Based Zombies, the fan-favorite mode where players will take down hordes of the undead in two brand-new maps at launch. Post-launch, players can look forward to even more exciting maps and groundbreaking experiences dropping into both Multiplayer and Zombies. **Cross Save**
